placeholders.<WORK>: a scratch directory that exists; substitute your own
placeholders.<PORT>: the loopback port the registry double bound
placeholders.<INPUT_FRAME>: the frame field equals the input frame

cases.name: save: an empty state
cases.divergence: DELIBERATE DIVERGENCE from the pre-rebuild code, decided by the user 2026-09-20. M3a Task 5 added ZoneState.positions, seconds into an MPD channel by channel number, because MPD keeps no position per stored playlist and an audiobook nobody writes down starts again from the beginning after every restart. The field has a default, so the INPUT of this case is untouched - a state file written before this version still loads, and loads with no positions, which is what the load cases here now prove. What moved is the shape of what a load produces and the bytes a save writes. A further field joined the same way on 2026-09-24, decided by the user (OPEN-WORK rank 188): hold_threshold_s, how long a key must stay down to be held rather than tapped, which a calibration now measures beside the dialling window instead of sharing its value. It carries a default, so no recorded INPUT changed and no recorded refusal moved; what moved is the shape of what is produced, which carries this one field more, placed after dial_window_s. A further field joined the same way on 2026-09-24, decided by the user (OPEN-WORK rank 191, house volume): owed_volume, the house-volume steps a box missed while it was off, taken when it next joins. It carries a default, so no recorded INPUT changed and no recorded refusal moved; what moved is the shape of what is produced, which carries this one field more, placed last, after hold_threshold_s.
